name: Pure canonical dish presentation and versioned serving-offer domain boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
scope: Only immutable versioned dish presentations and serving offers. No separate mutable dish registry. Existing FOOD-001 and untracked FOOD-002A remain unchanged.

rules: Supplied explicitly; nonempty canonical string/local component with no surrounding whitespace or additional colon.
Match FOOD-001 local-ID semantics, preserving internal canonical text rather than adding unrelated identity restrictions.
Reject rather than trim, normalize, infer or generate. Stable dish ID contains no changing product/recipe reference.

recordTypes.FoodDishPresentation: Readonly<{ dishId: FoodDishId; version: number; product: Readonly<{ id: FoodProductId; version: number }>; recipe: Readonly<{ id: FoodRecipeId; version: number }>; name: string; shortDescription?: string; longDescription?: string; mediaReferences?: readonly Readonly<{ reference: string }>[] }>
recordTypes.FoodServingOffer: Readonly<{ offerId: FoodServingOfferId; version: number; presentation: Readonly<{ dishId: FoodDishId; version: number }>; format: FoodServingFormat; servingEstimate: FoodServingEstimate; packagingDescription?: FoodUnresolvedText; storageSummary?: FoodUnresolvedText; reheatingSummary?: FoodUnresolvedText }>
recordTypes.FoodServingFormat: Readonly<{ kind: 'individual' }> | Readonly<{ kind: 'family' }> | Readonly<{ kind: 'catering'; panSize: 'unknown' | 'half-pan' | 'full-pan' | 'other'; panDescription?: string }> | Readonly<{ kind: 'custom'; code: string; label: string }>
recordTypes.FoodServingEstimate: Readonly<{ state: 'unknown' }> | Readonly<{ state: 'specified'; minimum: number; maximum: number; explanation?: string }>
recordTypes.FoodUnresolvedText: Readonly<{ state: 'unknown' }> | Readonly<{ state: 'specified'; text: string }>

contextValidation: validateFoodDishPresentation validates actual supplied product/recipe through FOOD-001A unchanged.
Presentation product ID/version and recipe ID/version exactly match validated contextual snapshots; product itself references that exact recipe.
Offer validation validates supplied presentation and its contextual product/recipe, then matches exact presentation dish ID/version.
Output retains references only, never private snapshots/evidence/reviewer/operating data.
No latest/floating references, implicit lookup or latest substitution. Runtime validation does not trust branded types alone.

textRules.canonical: Every supplied text field is a nonempty string when present; reject surrounding whitespace, malformed values and over-limit values without trimming, case folding, Unicode normalization or defaults.
textRules.customCode: Canonical supplied nonempty local identifier, no surrounding whitespace or colon, maximum 128 code units; preserve case and internal supplied characters under FOOD-001 local-ID style.
textRules.identityLimits: No new length limit on dish/offer IDs beyond existing FOOD-001-style canonical identity semantics.
textRules.claims: Text validation is structural only, never semantic censorship, truth/rights/safety/publication/legal verification. Candidate descriptions are not approved public facts.

media: Optional ordered opaque shared-media references containing only reference; canonical bounded text, duplicate exact references rejected.
Absent mediaReferences means not recorded; explicit empty array records no references. Preserve order.

Reference is opaque, not a URL. Reject URI-like references matching a leading scheme followed by colon and protocol-relative references beginning //; do not invent media ownership or resolve references.
No URL fields, upload, ownership flags, render configuration, approval booleans or second media subsystem.
formatRules: Half-pan/full-pan are catering panSize values, never competing top-level kinds.
Catering panSize other requires bounded canonical panDescription; description forbidden for all other panSize values.
Individual/family have only kind; custom has only kind/code/label.
No generated custom codes, extension bags or bundle kind.
servingEstimates: Specified minimum/maximum are positive safe integers; minimum <= maximum, equal bounds valid.
Optional explanation must be bounded nonempty canonical text.
Never derive/multiply estimates from individual portions or fabricate them.
unresolvedSemantics: Omitted optional descriptor means not recorded.
Present state unknown means explicitly unresolved; specified text means supplied descriptive information only.
Reject null as unknown substitute, empty strings, inferred/default values and malformed/extra variant fields.
Specified never implies reviewed, tested or approved.
offerRevisions: Offers revise independently while retaining an exact presentation reference.
Adopting another presentation requires an explicit new offer revision.
Same FoodServingOfferId remains associated with the same FoodDishId; moving it to another dish is invalid.
Do not duplicate product/recipe references on offers; provenance is through the exact presentation.
descriptiveScope: Only packagingDescription, storageSummary and reheatingSummary on offer.
No minimum purchase quantity, lead time, cutoffs, capacity weight, fulfillment restrictions, availability or readiness; defer to later operational/publication boundaries.
deferredPrice: No money/currency/price/tax/discount/fee/payment semantics. Later pricing may use safe integer minor units with explicit currency.
deferredOrganization: No tags, menu categories, featured state, badges or structured dietary/health/legal/compliance claims. Menu organization and claim review are later publication concerns; free-text validation does not verify claims.
deferredBundles: Future separate bundle records reference exact component offer versions and explicit quantities. No bundle format, custom extension metadata or duplicated dishes.
versionRules: Reuse FOOD-001A validateFoodVersion: positive safe integer, no coercion.
Standalone validators accept any valid historical positive version.
Revision helpers require same stable identity and next version exactly previous.version + 1; reject MAX_SAFE_INTEGER overflow.
Initial version 1 enforcement, latest/current enforcement, conflicts/retries/durable sequencing/append history belong to later repositories.
apis: reviseFoodDishPresentation(previous, next, previousProduct, previousRecipe, nextProduct, nextRecipe)
reviseFoodServingOffer(previous, next, previousPresentation, nextPresentation, previousProduct, previousRecipe, nextProduct, nextRecipe)
validationRules: All public validators accept unknown runtime inputs; reject malformed variants, unknown properties, mismatched IDs/versions, invalid nested shapes and references.
Optional properties omitted/undefined follow FOOD-001 conventions; supplied null or malformed values reject.
Reject unsupported own fields instead of silently retaining or repairing them.
Reuse only FOOD-001A domain authority; commerce/insurance/Sesh patterns are not food semantics.
revisionRules: Validate complete previous record/context and complete next record/context.
Require exact predecessor+1 and unchanged stable ID; offer revisions also enforce stable dish association.
Full replacement only: never merge or silently copy omitted optional fields.
No generated versions, implicit historical lookup or I/O.
immutability: Every successful object output is detached and recursively frozen, including arrays, nested references and value objects.
Accept frozen valid inputs and leave all caller inputs/history untouched.
Deterministic results; no timestamps, random/generated IDs, caches, framework state or I/O.
tests: Canonical and malformed dish/offer IDs; reject wrong prefixes, blank local components, surrounding whitespace, extra colons and coercion.
Positive safe historical versions, invalid versions and revision overflow.
Exact product mismatch, recipe mismatch and product-to-recipe mismatch; no latest/floating references.
Valid presentation and revision; no private data retained.
Valid offer, independent revision, explicit presentation adoption, stable dish association and attempted dish move rejection.
Custom canonical code/label, unsupported format/bundle/extension rejection.
Unknown estimate, specified range, equal bounds, invalid/unsafe/fractional/reversed bounds.
Omitted descriptor versus unknown versus specified; null/empty/malformed variant rejection.
Canonical text length boundaries and no normalization/claims-verification overclaims.
Opaque ordered media, absent/empty distinctions, duplicates and URL-like reference rejection.
Unknown fields at every nested shape; reject publication/availability/pricing/readiness/rating/customer/QR/extension fields.
Detached recursively frozen output, frozen inputs, no history mutation, full-replacement revisions and deterministic behavior.
Source isolation: FOOD-001A authority only, no persistence/framework/runtime/network/filesystem/time/randomness or unrelated subsystem imports.
futureValidation: Strict TypeScript checks for new files
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification, keeping existing FOOD-002A untouched. Do not implement, stage, commit or push.
nextStep: Review specification before separately authorizing the two-file pure domain implementation.
